title: The team comes first
sub: The third film of Leading a data team, the third series of Leading data people: Ubuntu, a person is a person through other people. A new data manager reads her team as a whole before judging anyone, and finds one person answering every night alert alone. The team pairs until four can answer them, and when he has to leave at a day's notice, the rota holds, and nobody calls him.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's sunlit plaster: the team's rooms in daylight, with sheets pinned to the wall. Its colours mean the same in every film: blue is plans and design (a group's rules, the rota, a runbook, a definition in the glossary), green is something done or of value (savings, an alert answered, a mistake thanked), amber a cost or a risk (no bank to save in, one person answering every alert), orange is data, and violet only an agent.
